items.name: PowerPoint_Generator
items.description: A Flask-based web app for generating professional PowerPoint presentations using AI. Powered by DeepSeek, it creates content based on user inputs and populates .pptx templates. Features Google OAuth, admin dashboard, security level tagging, and SQLite logging.

items.name: pptx-generator
items.description: Professional PowerPoint presentation generator using PptxGenJS with McKinsey-style templates

items.name: DOCX_PPTX
items.description: This system automatically converts structured .docx documents into professional PowerPoint presentations using customizable templates.

items.name: slidex
items.description: A full-stack application for generating AI-powered presentations. Features a modern tech stack, a credit-based payment system with Stripe, and a variety of professional templates.

items.name: nano-banana-pptx
items.description: Nano Banana PPTX transforms your ideas into stunning, AI-generated presentations where every slide is a bespoke full-bleed visual powered by Google's Gemini 3 Pro Image model. No more generic templates — each presentation is a unique work of art assembled into a professional .pptx file.

items.name: ai-powerpoint-generator
items.description: 🤖 AI-powered PowerPoint presentation generator using FastAPI, LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini), and python-pptx. Transform text content into professional presentations with custom templates. Features secure API handling, real-time generation, and downloadable PPTX output.

items.name: DocCraft
items.description: DocCraft is a Laravel-based AI automation platform that generates professional documents and presentations (PDF & PPTX) using Gemini API with dynamic templates.

items.name: ppt_assistant
items.description: A powerful Python PPT generation tool that supports reading content from JSON format, applying .pptx templates, and outputting professional presentations containing text, images, tables, and charts.

items.name: ppt-maker
items.description: PPT Master is an AI-powered presentation platform that transforms text, documents, PDFs, and prompts into professional PowerPoint presentations. It features a drag-and-drop editor, customizable templates, AI-assisted slide generation, collaboration tools, and PPTX/PDF export.

items.name: .github
items.description: LibreOffice delivers professional document creation, spreadsheet analysis, and presentation design. Compatible with major file formats including DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX. Includes advanced macro support, templates, and collaborative review tools for teams.

items.name: PPTGenie
items.description: PPTGenie is an AI-powered web app built with React, TypeScript, and TanStack that transforms simple prompts into professional presentations. Create, manage, and customize stunning slides instantly using smart AI generation and beautifully designed templates.
